detail:
New decision "Incompatible CLI flag combos are rejected at parse time (exit 2) rather than reinterpreted" relates to:
- 01KWMYW8EYSG7H5MWVSS19AZYQ: "W3 1.x migrate leaves config.version at 1 and only flips storage.backend"
- 01KWN892XYHWDFBFBRVQP8E67A: "Reverse under export_records:false SKIPS ingest and exports from the database alone"
- 01KWN893175YCE3S3KR6F2F1KQ: "pre-reverse-backup/ is deliberately LAST-WINS (unlike config-edit's first-wins .pre-migrate.bak): it means 'what this run is about to overwrite', which is what makes a mistaken second reverse recoverable."
summary: Related decisions in scope: 3 existing decision(s) overlap
